_comment_1: OTA channel endpoints. Passed to every build with --dart-define-from-file=config/ota.json so the iOS script, CI and local builds cannot drift apart.
_comment_2: Nothing here is secret. These are public Supabase Storage objects, deliberately readable with no credentials so the force-update gate works for a logged-out user on a build too old to log in. The project ref is already public in lib/config/supabase_config.dart.
_comment_3: Set a value to "" to switch that channel OFF. The clients treat an empty URL as dormant: no network call is made and every value falls back to its compiled-in default.
